title: Three Days and One Short Bowl
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：pizza　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 pizza 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1980 the cook ① shared the pizza that no guest in the canteen would have counted, and he said the sharing was the whole of the day. The ② pizza, meaning the pie itself and not the bowl, ran three days and stayed uncounted in the book; a pizza, he said, is the only thing in a canteen that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ pizza in that canteen had the same short bowl beside it, and the ④ pizza at the far table, meaning the portion they kept for the children to share and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A pizza, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the cook said the counting is the part that fills three days.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the pizza was the whole of the matter, meaning the share and not the pie. The ⑥ pizza, meaning the share and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; pizza, he said, is either something you share or the only word that means both a pie and a share. He said the share is the part they remember.

By 1985 the ⑦ pizza had become a line in a menu, and the menu had become an argument about the short bowl. The ⑧ pizza of the whole thing, the cook wrote in September, was one canteen and three days of counting; pizza, he said, is either the portion at the far table or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ pizza I remember is the pie counted in the menu, which closed in 1987 and is still counted as the quietest in the canteen. A ⑩ pizza, my mother said in 1989, is the only pie that improves by being counted; every pizza, she said, is a share that has agreed to look like a pie. She said the share was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 比萨饼（指食堂里每一块旁边的那一块）
B. n. 比萨饼（指那块比萨饼本身，与小小的碗相对）
C. 固定搭配：share the pizza 分这一块比萨饼
D. n. 比萨饼（指留给孩子们分着吃的那一份）
E. n. 比萨饼之事（抽象总称，指一处食堂的比萨饼之事）
F. n. 比萨饼（指菜单里写到、被清点的那一块）
G. n. 比萨饼、分食（指一件事里人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 分食（抽象总称，指人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: shared the pizza that no guest in the canteen would have counted
The pizza, meaning the pie itself and not the bowl
the pizza at the far table
the pizza was the whole of the matter
the pizza had become a line in a menu
The pizza of the whole thing
A pizza, my mother said in 1989

answers.why: share the pizza 意为“分这一块比萨饼”，1980 年那位厨子把食堂里没有一位客人肯清点的一块比萨饼做了一遍。
pizza 意为“比萨饼”，指那块比萨饼本身而不是小小的碗，它经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被清点。
pizza 意为“比萨饼”，指食堂里每一块旁边的那一块，每一块旁边都有同一只小小的碗。
pizza 意为“比萨饼”，指最远那张桌角的留给孩子们分着吃的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
pizza 意为“比萨饼、分食”，指一件事里人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这块分食就是那件事的全部。
pizza 意为“分食”，指人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西而不是那块比萨饼，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
pizza 意为“比萨饼”，指菜单里写到、被清点的那一块，到 1985 年这一块成了菜单里的一行。
pizza 意为“比萨饼之事”，厨子九月写道，整件事的比萨饼之事是一处食堂和三个日子的清点。
pizza 意为“比萨饼”，我记得的是菜单里清点过的那一块，1987 年开完了，至今仍被说成食堂里最安静的一块。
pizza 为抽象总称，母亲 1989 年说，比萨饼是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的比萨饼。
